input: effects: explicit record paths and optional condition paths
independent_effects.output: Evaluate each named record separately under its own established conditions, additionally conjoined with any listed condition or negation of an unless condition (unknown preserved). Return all effects; no implication that any record overrides another or that available choices are exclusive.

attach_requirements.output: Return a typed requirement bundle for target. Each item retains its own conditional scope and provenance. A missing field or unknown trigger leaves that item unresolved. This emits required content/method/time/location; it does not treat existence of the legal field as proof of case compliance.

cost_component.output: Modify only storage component of the target payment requirement. Preserve advertising/sale costs and all nonpayment conditions. Unknown claimant, reasonableness, allocation, actual cost or condition prevents a final amount. Case ledger items require stable IDs, kind, property-interest allocation and previously charged cost IDs.

notice_methods.output: Return authorized notice-method alternatives with their own sender/recipient/location/agreement conditions and deemed-service rules. Never treat an additional method as substitute. Satisfaction requires classified facts, not merely existence of the method record.

calendar_binding.output: Compute only after accepted interval/direction/anchor and classified event dates are available. Copy anchor from selected target field; calendar service defaults cannot silently replace an express entry anchor.

conditional_expiration.output: Permission ends at accepted expiry unless established continuation condition holds; unknown continuation at expiration keeps availability unresolved. Other permission conditions remain required.

waive_duty.output: Remove only the named mandatory performance requirement when condition holds. Do not declare the conduct prohibited, and do not assert the alternative was elected. Unknown condition leaves duty status unresolved.

alternative_route.output: Expose a separately conditioned permissible route without suppressing original legal requirements by implication. Does not itself supply scope or procedural conditions of chosen route.
